R2D2 penalized DLM in RTMB

Source: R/penalized_dlm.R
r2d2_dlm.Rd

function to fit a dynamic linear regression model with r2dr shrinkage prior.

Usage

r2d2_dlm(
  dat,
  form = y ~ x,
  alpha_dirichlet = NULL,
  scale_evol = TRUE,
  R2_a = 0.5,
  R2_b = NULL,
  rho_a = 3,
  rho_b = 2,
  intercept_n_equiv = 3,
  sd_init_intercept = 1,
  phi_a = 3,
  phi_b = 2,
  weird_jacob = FALSE,
  log_correct = FALSE
)

Arguments

dat

dataframe with response and predictors

form

formula specifying linear predictor

alpha_dirichlet

if null, 1 / number of covariates

scale_evol

whether to scale the variance of the dynamic part by the time series length so that it gets equivalent penalization as the initial value

R2_a

alpha for beta prior on R2

R2_b

alpha for beta prior on R2, if null (default) equal to number of covariates / 2

rho_a

alpha for beta prior on split between static and dynamic. default puts slightly more weight on static.

rho_b

beta for beta prior on split between static and dynamic. default puts slightly more weight on static.

intercept_n_equiv

multiplier on the amount of variance given to average covariate, which is given to intercept.

sd_init_intercept

sd on the intercept initial value

Value

the fitted TMB model object, which has the NLL and the linear predictors in the report()

Details

Predictors are standardized using all rows except the final forecast row. The same historical means and standard deviations are applied to that row.
